name: Bunbury Internet Service
summary: Regional WA ISP (Bunbury Internet Service, 7 Teede St, Bunbury) holding a full /21 (BUNBURYINT-AU 203.18.248.0-203.18.255.255) in the 1997 IP Network Index. The exact same /21 is now registered in APNIC whois to Ciphertel Pty Ltd, Unit 3/9 Bourke Street, Bunbury (object registered 4 Sep 2008) — a Bunbury-based licensed carrier/ISP — indicating Bunbury Internet Service's address space (and presumably its business) passed to Ciphertel around 2008.

events.details: Existing by 1997: allocated the contiguous /21 BUNBURYINT-AU 203.18.248.0-203.18.255.255 (Bunbury WA) in the 1997 IP Network Index.

The /21 203.18.248.0-203.18.255.255 is registered in APNIC whois to Ciphertel Pty Ltd (netname CIPHERTEL-NON-AU), Unit 3/9 Bourke Street, Bunbury WA 6230, with the network object registered 4 Sep 2008. Ciphertel is a Bunbury-based licensed carrier/ISP. UNCERTAIN whether this was an acquisition of Bunbury Internet Service's business by Ciphertel or a pivot of the same business under the Ciphertel name; the transfer of the exact same address block to a same-city ISP is the documented evidence (dated by 4 Sep 2008).
